---
title: "Pilot figure generation"
output: html_document
params:
  mode: "mock"
  input_files: !r character()
  output_dir: "analysis/output/mock"
  bootstrap_draws: 2000
  exclusions: !r NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# This file is an analysis/figure script, not a written report.
# render_figures.R executes its R chunks without producing an HTML report.
if (!exists('params')) params <- list(mode = 'mock', input_files = character(),
                                     output_dir = 'analysis/output/mock',
                                     bootstrap_draws = 2000, exclusions = NULL)
if (!exists('repo_root')) repo_root <- normalizePath('.')
source(file.path(repo_root, 'analysis/R/data.R'))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
catalog <- read_catalog(repo_root)
stopifnot(params$mode %in% c('mock', 'production'), params$bootstrap_draws >= 200)
output <- if (grepl('^/', params$output_dir)) params$output_dir else file.path(repo_root, params$output_dir)
dir.create(output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
output <- normalizePath(output)
if (params$mode == 'production' &&
    !startsWith(paste0(output, '/'), paste0(repo_root, '/analysis/output/')))
  stop('Production outputs must stay in ignored analysis/output/.')
if (params$mode == 'mock') {
  if (length(params$input_files)) stop('Mock mode does not accept real input files.')
  ratings <- simulate_ratings(catalog)
} else {
  imported <- load_ratings(params$input_files, catalog, exclusions = params$exclusions)
  ratings <- imported$ratings
  write_csv(imported$import_audit, file.path(output, 'import-audit.csv'))
}
mock <- params$mode == 'mock'
prefix <- if (mock) 'MOCK DATA | ' else ''
label <- if (mock) 'Simulated illustration of the proposed hypothesis. Not pilot results.' else
  'Production pilot ratings. Descriptive, exploratory comparisons.'
B <- params$bootstrap_draws
cells <- summarise_ratings(ratings, B)
gaps <- contrast_rows(ratings, catalog$versions, B)
advantages <- construction_advantage(ratings, catalog$versions, B)
write_csv(mutate(cells, data_kind = params$mode), file.path(output, 'cell-summary.csv'))
write_csv(mutate(gaps, data_kind = params$mode), file.path(output, 'cause-gap-summary.csv'))
write_csv(mutate(advantages$boosts, data_kind = params$mode), file.path(output, 'construction-advantage.csv'))
write_csv(mutate(advantages$contrasts, data_kind = params$mode), file.path(output, 'construction-interaction.csv'))
# No automatic language/speed exclusions, significance tests, or candidate ranking.
# Means are descriptive summaries of the 1-7 ordinal responses.
# Each cell has one rating per participant. Percentile bootstrap CIs resample people
# within cells. Gap contrasts subtract paired ratings before independent group resampling.
# These are pointwise 95% intervals, not simultaneous or selection-adjusted intervals.
# Shared thick observations are reused as references; repeated panels are not new samples.
```

```{r figure-functions, include=FALSE}
colors <- c(Thick = '#006B8F', Thin = '#BA4B21')
theme_pilot <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = 'sans') +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 17, color = '#172B3A'),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = '#445563', margin = margin(b = 14)),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = '#52616B', margin = margin(t = 14)),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = '#E5EBEF', linewidth = .35),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = '#EDF2F5', color = NA),
          strip.text = element_text(face = 'bold', color = '#233746', margin = margin(9, 7, 9, 7)),
          legend.position = 'top', legend.title = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.1, 'lines'),
          plot.margin = margin(15, 22, 15, 16))
}
candidate_labels <- function(study) {
  switch(study, Absences = c(direct = 'Direct cause', absence = 'Omission'),
         Factivity = c(direct = 'Event (direct)', fact = 'Fact-denoting'),
         Chains = c(proximal = 'Direct (proximal)', distal = 'Distal cause'))
}
format_data <- function(d, study) {
  labs <- candidate_labels(study)
  if (!'verb_condition' %in% names(d)) d$verb_condition <- NA_character_
  d %>% mutate(candidate_label = factor(unname(labs[candidate]), levels = unname(labs)),
               construction_label = factor(construction, levels = c('lexical', 'cause'),
                                           labels = c('Lexical verb', 'Cause + verb')),
               verb_group = factor(verb_condition, levels = c('thick', 'thin'), labels = c('Thick', 'Thin')))
}
comparison_summary <- function(versions) {
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(versions)), function(i) {
    v <- versions[i, ]; labs <- candidate_labels(v$study)
    scaffold <- crossing(verb_condition = c('thick', 'thin'), candidate = names(labs),
                         construction = c('lexical', 'cause')) %>%
      mutate(study = v$study, case = v$case,
             variant = if_else(verb_condition == 'thick', v$thick_variant, v$variant))
    scaffold %>% left_join(cells, by = c('study', 'case', 'variant', 'verb_condition', 'candidate', 'construction')) %>%
      mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L), version_label = paste0(v$doc_heading, '\n', v$thin_label, ' vs ', v$thick_label))
  }))
}
comparison_caption <- function(versions) {
  note <- unique(versions$comparison_note[nzchar(versions$comparison_note)])
  paste(c(label, 'Points: means; whiskers: pointwise 95% bootstrap CIs. n = participants per cell.',
          'Thick reference data may appear in multiple panels; they are counted once in overviews.', note), collapse = '\n')
}
profile_plot <- function(versions) {
  d <- format_data(comparison_summary(versions), versions$study[1])
  ggplot(d, aes(construction_label, mean, color = verb_group, shape = verb_group, group = verb_group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = .9, alpha = .8, position = position_dodge(width = .12), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), width = .065, linewidth = .65,
                  position = position_dodge(width = .12), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 3.1, position = position_dodge(width = .12), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_text(aes(y = .68, label = paste0('n=', n)), size = 3.1,
              position = position_dodge(width = .5), show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_grid(version_label ~ candidate_label, switch = 'y') +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Thick = 16, Thin = 17), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:7, limits = c(.5, 7.4)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = .45)) +
    labs(title = paste0(prefix, versions$study[1], ': effect of adding "cause"'),
         subtitle = 'A steeper upward line means a larger increase from lexical verb to cause + verb.',
         x = NULL, y = 'Mean naturalness (1-7)', caption = comparison_caption(versions)) + theme_pilot() +
    theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0), strip.placement = 'outside')
}
advantage_plot <- function(versions) {
  scaffold <- crossing(versions %>% select(study, case, variant, doc_heading),
                        candidate = names(candidate_labels(versions$study[1])),
                        verb_condition = c('thick', 'thin'))
  d <- scaffold %>% left_join(advantages$boosts,
    by = c('study', 'case', 'variant', 'candidate', 'verb_condition')) %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L), construction = 'cause', version_label = doc_heading) %>%
    format_data(versions$study[1])
  all_values <- c(advantages$boosts$mean, advantages$boosts$low, advantages$boosts$high)
  all_values <- all_values[is.finite(all_values)]
  bounds <- c(min(-1, floor(min(c(0, all_values)))), max(4, ceiling(max(c(0, all_values)))))
  ggplot(d, aes(verb_group, mean, color = verb_group, shape = verb_group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = '#7C8B96', linewidth = .5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), width = .09, linewidth = .75, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 3.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_grid(version_label ~ candidate_label, switch = 'y') +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Thick = 16, Thin = 17), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = bounds, breaks = seq(bounds[1], bounds[2], 1)) +
    labs(title = paste0(prefix, versions$study[1], ': advantage of "cause + verb"'),
         subtitle = 'Compare the thick and thin increases within each causal subject.',
         x = NULL, y = 'Mean increase (cause + verb minus lexical verb)',
         caption = paste(label, 'Points: mean within-person differences; whiskers: pointwise 95% bootstrap CIs.',
                         paste(unique(versions$comparison_note[nzchar(versions$comparison_note)]), collapse = '\n'), sep = '\n')) +
    theme_pilot() + theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0), strip.placement = 'outside',
                          legend.position = 'none')
}
difference_plot <- function(versions) {
  d <- comparison_summary(versions)
  set.seed(642)
  diff <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(versions)), function(i) {
    v <- versions[i, ]; raw <- comparison_rows(ratings, v)
    bind_rows(lapply(names(candidate_labels(v$study)), function(cand) {
      bind_rows(lapply(c('lexical', 'cause'), function(form) {
        a <- raw$rating[raw$candidate == cand & raw$construction == form & raw$verb_condition == 'thick']
        b <- raw$rating[raw$candidate == cand & raw$construction == form & raw$verb_condition == 'thin']
        ci <- c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
        if (min(length(a), length(b)) >= 2) ci <- quantile(replicate(B,
          mean(sample(b, length(b), TRUE)) - mean(sample(a, length(a), TRUE))), c(.025, .975), names = FALSE)
        tibble(candidate = cand, construction = form, version_label = v$doc_heading,
               difference = if (length(a) && length(b)) mean(b) - mean(a) else NA_real_,
               low = ci[1], high = ci[2], n_thick = length(a), n_thin = length(b))
      }))
    }))
  }))
  if (!nrow(diff)) return(ggplot() + labs(title = paste0(prefix, 'No observations for this comparison')) + theme_void())
  d <- format_data(diff, versions$study[1]) %>%
    mutate(row_label = paste(version_label, candidate_label, sep = ' | '),
           row_label = factor(row_label, levels = rev(unique(row_label))))
  observed <- c(d$difference, d$low, d$high)
  limit <- max(2, ceiling(max(c(0, abs(observed[is.finite(observed)])))))
  ggplot(d, aes(difference, row_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = '#65747E', linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = .55) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), orientation = 'y', width = .12,
                  color = '#243D50', linewidth = .8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, fill = '#BA4B21', color = 'white', stroke = .8, size = 3.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~construction_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-limit, limit), breaks = pretty(c(-limit, limit), n = 5)) +
    labs(title = paste0(prefix, versions$study[1], ': thin minus thick'),
         subtitle = 'Left of zero: thick rated higher. Right of zero: thin rated higher.',
         x = 'Difference in mean naturalness (thin - thick)', y = NULL,
         caption = paste(label, 'Dots: independent-group mean differences; whiskers: pointwise 95% bootstrap CIs.',
                         paste(unique(versions$comparison_note[nzchar(versions$comparison_note)]), collapse = '\n'), sep = '\n')) +
    theme_pilot() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = '#E5EBEF'), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
overview_plot <- function(study, condition) {
  versions <- catalog$versions %>% filter(.data$study == .env$study)
  if (condition == 'thick') {
    # One row per collected thick material version, even if it is a reference for several thin alternatives.
    versions <- versions %>% mutate(variant = thick_variant) %>% distinct(case, variant, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }
  labels <- if (condition == 'thin') versions$doc_heading else versions$thick_heading
  versions$overview_label <- labels
  candidate_order <- names(candidate_labels(study))
  scaffold <- crossing(versions %>% select(study, case, variant, overview_label),
                        candidate = candidate_order, construction = c('lexical', 'cause')) %>%
    mutate(verb_condition = condition)
  d <- scaffold %>% left_join(cells, by = c('study', 'case', 'variant', 'verb_condition', 'candidate', 'construction')) %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L), overview_label = factor(overview_label, levels = rev(labels))) %>% format_data(study)
  ggplot(d, aes(candidate_label, overview_label, fill = mean)) +
    geom_tile(color = 'white', linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = if_else(n > 0, sprintf('%.1f\nn=%d', mean, n), 'No data'),
                  color = if_else(!is.na(mean) & mean >= 4.7, 'light', 'dark')), size = 3.3, lineheight = 1.05) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(light = 'white', dark = '#163248'), guide = 'none') +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c('#F4F6F8', '#C7E4E5', '#53A6AC', '#155E75'),
                         limits = c(1, 7), breaks = c(1, 4, 7), na.value = '#F7F7F7', name = 'Mean\nnaturalness') +
    facet_grid(. ~ construction_label) +
    labs(title = paste0(prefix, study, ': ', condition, ' versions'),
         subtitle = 'Read across a row to see each version\'s four ratings.',
         x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = paste(label, 'Cells: mean and participant n. Shared thick references appear once.',
                         'Use the per-version profile plots for uncertainty intervals.', sep = '\n')) +
    theme_pilot() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = 'right',
                           axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
}
save_plot <- function(plot, stem, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(output, paste0(stem, '.png')), plot, width = width, height = height,
         dpi = 180, bg = 'white')
  ggsave(file.path(output, paste0(stem, '.pdf')), plot, width = width, height = height,
         device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, bg = 'white')
}
```

```{r generate-figures, include=FALSE}
placement <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(catalog$versions))) {
  v <- catalog$versions[i, ]
  stem <- paste(tolower(v$study), v$case, v$variant, sep = '-')
  save_plot(profile_plot(v), paste0(stem, '-profile'), 10, 5.2)
  save_plot(advantage_plot(v), paste0(stem, '-construction-advantage'), 10, 5.2)
  save_plot(difference_plot(v), paste0(stem, '-difference'), 10, 4.6)
  placement[[i]] <- v %>% select(study, case, variant, doc_heading, thick_variant, context_match, comparison_note) %>%
    left_join(catalog$studies %>% select(study, document_id), by = 'study') %>%
    mutate(profile_file = paste0(stem, '-profile.png'), difference_file = paste0(stem, '-difference.png'),
           construction_advantage_file = paste0(stem, '-construction-advantage.png'),
           data_kind = params$mode, placement = 'Immediately after this section\'s materials table')
}
for (study in catalog$studies$study) {
  for (condition in c('thick', 'thin')) {
    n_rows <- if (condition == 'thin') sum(catalog$versions$study == study) else
      catalog$allocation %>% filter(.data$study == .env$study, verb_condition == 'thick') %>%
      distinct(case, variant) %>% nrow()
    save_plot(overview_plot(study, condition), paste(tolower(study), condition, 'overview', sep = '-'),
              11, max(5, n_rows * .52 + 2.8))
  }
}
# These are the two alternative displays to compare using the same beach data.
beach <- catalog$versions %>% filter(study == 'Absences', case == 'beach')
save_plot(profile_plot(beach), 'example-1-profile', 11, 7.4)
save_plot(advantage_plot(beach), 'example-3-construction-advantage', 11, 7.4)
save_plot(profile_plot(catalog$versions %>% filter(study == 'Factivity', variant == 'stop_working')),
          'example-factivity-construction', 10, 5.2)
save_plot(profile_plot(catalog$versions %>% filter(study == 'Chains', case == 'frame', variant == 'deform')),
          'example-chains-construction', 10, 5.2)
save_plot(difference_plot(beach), 'example-2-difference', 11, 4.9)
write_csv(bind_rows(placement), file.path(output, 'google-doc-figure-placement.csv'))
# Deliberately no Google Docs writes until the figure style has been chosen.
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(output, 'R-session-info.txt'))
message('Figures saved to ', output, ' [', params$mode, ']. No report generated.')
```
